title: Embouchure learned from Lorenzo Tio, and how others held the lip
summary: He got his embouchure from Tio, does not bite the lip, and says Papa Tio held his lip the same while Big Eye bit down.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Before I forget, I don't like to interrupt you, but I want to ask about T.O. How did he hold his lips?
The same way. He gave me that amazure. That's why I got my amazure from T.O.
Young T.O. Lorenzo.
And I never had no difficulty, no trouble. I never did point out.
I'm not real sure. Do you put your lip underneath your teeth or just even?
No, even. I don't put it underneath. I don't bite the lip. You don't bite the lip? No, I don't bite the lip at all. See my horn sets like that, sir.
Yeah.
On top of the lip. I don't bite my lip.
Yeah.
And then the other one, I just bring it flush with the teeth. But you press with your lip a good deal? Yeah.
You don't let your teeth get on the mouthpiece?
No. My teeth don't cut my mouthpiece because I keep the pressure on my lip.
But you don't bite your lip either, though?
No. No. No, it's white. Ain't got no corn, nothing on that.
Yeah. You don't put your teeth on your lip, but right even.

Right even. Yeah. Teeth and them. Blurred together. Never bite my lip. Now I've got more difficult pain. That's why I'm missing. I've got my teeth being out. So many teeth I've got out. I've only got five more to come out at the top. All the back's out already. Mm-hmm. All this side, look.
Mm-hmm.
All that side.

All that side. Do you know how old man Papa Teo played? How did he hold his lip first? Same way. Yeah, I didn't listen with him too. And what about Big Eye? Do you remember how Big Eye played? Big Eye? Really?

I used to see him, but I never paid any attention. Big Eye, they used to play a little on the side like that. Just a little bit. Did he bite, put his teeth on the mouthpiece? Yeah, he bit down on the mouthpiece. He bit. Mm-hmm.
